title: Constitution of India — Article 14 (illustrative excerpt)
text: Article 14 states that the State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.

title: Constitution of India — Article 21 (illustrative excerpt)
text: Article 21 states that no person shall be deprived of life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

title: Constitution of India — Article 32 (illustrative excerpt)
text: Article 32 provides the right to move the Supreme Court by appropriate proceedings for enforcement of rights conferred by Part III.

title: Supreme Court of India — Judgments service (illustrative source note)
text: The Supreme Court of India publishes a judgments service. A legal researcher should open the linked primary judgment to verify the holding, bench, date, citation and subsequent treatment before relying on it.

title: Indian Kanoon — case law search (illustrative source note)
text: Indian Kanoon is a searchable Indian legal repository. Search results are discovery aids; statutory text and judicial decisions should be checked against an authoritative source where possible.
